domains.steel_reinforcement: Steel reinforcement bars and structural steel
domains.led_street_lighting: LED luminaires for road and street lighting
domains.water_storage_pipes: Plastic water storage tanks and PVC water pipes

standards.title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires (TMT / HYSD rebars) used as reinforcement in concrete, covering strength grades such as Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550 and Fe 600, chemical composition, mechanical properties, bend and rebend tests, marking and supply.

standards.title: Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for hot rolled steel plates, strips, sections, flats and bars of medium and high tensile strength used in structural work such as buildings, bridges, towers and fabricated steel structures, in grades E250 to E650.

standards.title: Metallic materials - Tensile testing - Part 1: Method of test at room temperature
standards.scope: Method of tensile testing of metallic materials at room temperature to determine yield strength, tensile strength, elongation and reduction of area.

standards.title: Metallic materials - Bend test
standards.scope: Method for determining the ability of metallic materials to undergo plastic deformation in bending, used for bars, wires, plates and sections.

standards.title: Methods for chemical analysis of steels
standards.scope: Series of methods for determining carbon, sulphur, phosphorus, manganese and other elements in plain carbon and alloy steels.

standards.title: General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materials
standards.scope: General delivery conditions for metallurgical materials such as sampling, inspection, retests, rejection, test certificates and marking, referred to by many steel product standards.

standards.title: Glossary of terms relating to iron and steel
standards.scope: Definitions of terms used for iron and steel products, including steelmaking, rolling, sections and bars.

standards.title: Code of practice for bending and fixing of bars for concrete reinforcement
standards.scope: Practice for cutting, bending, placing, fixing and tying reinforcement bars at site in reinforced concrete work.

standards.title: Plain and reinforced concrete - Code of practice
standards.scope: Code of practice for the design and construction of plain and reinforced concrete structures, including requirements for materials, durability, cover and workmanship.

standards.title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V
standards.scope: Requirements for PVC insulated single-core and multi-core building wires, flexible cords and cables with copper or aluminium conductors for fixed wiring and appliances at voltages up to 450/750 V.

standards.title: PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables - Part 1: For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Requirements for PVC insulated, PVC sheathed heavy-duty power and control cables, armoured or unarmoured, with copper or aluminium conductors for voltages up to 1100 V.

standards.title: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables - Part 1: For working voltage up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Requirements for XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed power cables, armoured or unarmoured, with copper or aluminium conductors for low-voltage distribution up to 1100 V.

standards.title: Conductors for insulated electric cables and flexible cords - Specification
standards.scope: Classes, sizes and maximum resistance of copper and aluminium conductors used in insulated cables and flexible cords.

standards.title: PVC insulation and sheath of electric cables - Specification
standards.scope: Material requirements for PVC compounds used as insulation and sheath of electric cables.

standards.title: Methods of test for cables
standards.scope: Series of test methods for electric cables covering conductor resistance, insulation resistance, high voltage test, flammability, tensile strength of insulation and other properties.

standards.title: Recommended current ratings for cables - Part 2: PVC insulated and PVC sheathed heavy duty cables
standards.scope: Recommended continuous current ratings and derating factors for PVC insulated heavy-duty cables under standard installation conditions.

standards.title: Code of practice for installation and maintenance of power cables up to and including 33 kV rating
standards.scope: Practice for laying, jointing, terminating, testing and maintaining power cables in ground, ducts, trays and buildings.

standards.title: Code of practice for electrical wiring installations
standards.scope: Practice for design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of low-voltage electrical wiring installations in buildings.

standards.title: Electrotechnical vocabulary - Part 32: Electric cables
standards.scope: Terms and definitions relating to electric cables, their components and tests.

standards.title: Luminaires - Part 5: Particular requirements - Section 3: Luminaires for road and street lighting
standards.scope: Particular safety and construction requirements for luminaires used for road and street lighting, including LED street light fittings, with tungsten, discharge or LED light sources.

standards.title: Luminaires - Part 1: General requirements and tests
standards.scope: General safety requirements and tests for luminaires, covering classification, marking, construction, protection against electric shock, ingress protection and thermal endurance.

standards.title: Safety of lamp control gear - Part 2: Particular requirements - Section 13: d.c. or a.c. supplied electronic control gear for LED modules
standards.scope: Particular safety requirements for electronic control gear (LED drivers) supplied from a.c. or d.c. for use with LED modules.

standards.title: Method of measurement of lumen maintenance of solid state light (LED) sources
standards.scope: Method for measuring lumen depreciation of LED packages, arrays and modules over operating time.

standards.title: Method of electrical and photometric measurements of solid-state lighting (LED) products
standards.scope: Methods for measuring electrical power, luminous flux, efficacy, colour characteristics and light distribution of LED lamps and luminaires.

standards.title: General lighting - LEDs and LED modules - Terms and definitions
standards.scope: Terms and definitions for LEDs and LED modules used in general lighting.

standards.title: Degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP code)
standards.scope: Classification and tests for degrees of protection of electrical enclosures against ingress of solid objects, dust and water (IP ratings such as IP65, IP66).

standards.title: Code of practice for lighting of public thoroughfares - Parts 1 and 2
standards.scope: Practice for the lighting of roads and public thoroughfares, covering lighting levels, uniformity, mounting height, spacing and arrangement of luminaires.

standards.title: Grades of gold and gold alloys, jewellery/artefacts - Fineness and marking
standards.scope: Grades (fineness) of gold and gold alloys used for jewellery and artefacts, such as 14K, 18K, 22K and higher, and requirements for their marking.

standards.title: Assaying of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys, gold jewellery/artefacts - Cupellation (fire assay) method
standards.scope: Fire assay (cupellation) method for determining the gold content of bullion, alloys, jewellery and artefacts.

standards.title: Determination of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys and gold jewellery/artefacts - X-ray fluorescence (XRF) method
standards.scope: Non-destructive X-ray fluorescence method for estimating the gold content of bullion, alloys, jewellery and artefacts.

standards.title: Rotational moulded polyethylene water storage tanks - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for rotationally moulded polyethylene tanks for storage of potable water, covering material, capacity, wall thickness, colour, opacity and tests.

standards.title: Polyethylene for its safe use in contact with foodstuff, pharmaceuticals and drinking water - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for polyethylene materials intended to be in contact with food, pharmaceuticals and drinking water, including limits on additives and migration.

standards.title: Determination of overall migration of constituents of plastics materials and articles intended to come in contact with foodstuffs - Method of analysis
standards.scope: Method for determining the overall migration of constituents from plastic materials and articles into food simulants.

standards.title: Drinking water - Specification
standards.scope: Acceptable and permissible limits for physical, chemical and bacteriological parameters of drinking water.

standards.title: Unplasticized PVC pipes for water supplies - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for unplasticized PVC (uPVC) pipes used for cold potable water supply, covering pressure classes, dimensions, material and tests.

standards.title: Thermoplastics pipes and fittings - Methods of test
standards.scope: Series of test methods for thermoplastic pipes and fittings covering dimensions, hydrostatic pressure, impact strength, reversion and other properties.

standards.title: Plastics pipe selection, handling, storage and installation for potable water supplies - Code of practice - Part 3: Laying and jointing of UPVC pipes
standards.scope: Practice for laying, jointing and testing of unplasticized PVC pipelines for potable water supply.
